title: traffic regulations v1, one country
description: What a country's traffic law sets where no sign says otherwise, in skifahrer/traffic-signs: `regulations/<country>.json`. The map pipeline marks each road with its context (`urban`, `motorway`, …); Riki Maps reads the limit for that context and the vehicle from here, so a change in the law is a change of this file, not a new map.

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this schema's $id.

country.description: The country whose law this is, the same as the file's name.

unit.description: The unit of every speed in the file. Absent means km/h.

speed.description: The highest speed the law allows in each road context. Every context is listed, even where it repeats another, so a reader never guesses.

urban.description: A built-up area (`obec`, `Ortsgebiet`): between the signs that begin and end it.

motorway.description: A motorway (`highway=motorway`) outside a built-up area.

urban_motorway.description: A motorway inside a built-up area.

motorroad.description: A road for motor vehicles only that is not a motorway (`motorroad=yes`: `cesta pre motorové vozidlá`, `Kraftfahrstraße`), outside a built-up area.

urban_motorroad.description: The same inside a built-up area.

living_street.description: A living street, pedestrian or school zone: where pedestrians may use the whole road.

law.description: Where the numbers were read, so anyone can check them against the law.

name.description: The law as the country cites it: `Zákon č. 8/2009 Z. z. o cestnej premávke`.

version.description: The day from which the text that was read is in force, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

speed.description: In the file's unit; null where the law sets no limit (Germany's motorways).

limit.description: The limit for any vehicle the law does not single out, and for those it does. A vehicle left out drives at `default`.

default.description: A car, a motorcycle and a van up to 3.5 t without a trailer.

motorcycle.description: A motorcycle, where it differs from a car.

trailer.description: A vehicle up to 3.5 t with a trailer, a caravan among them.

section.description: Where in the law the numbers are: `§ 16 ods. 2, 3`.
